HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 10.07.2025 [Physical Hearing/Hybrid Hearing (as per request)] CRL.M.A. 19553/2025 (exemption)
1.
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. The accused/applicant seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 350/2025 of PS Karol Bagh for offence under Section 376(2)(n)/313/328/506/34/312 IPC.
3.

It is submitted on behalf of the accused/applicant that the version of the prosecutrix is not believable as she is a grown-up lady, four years older than the accused/applicant and as mentioned in the chargesheet, she did not cooperate with the investigation and did not hand over her mobile phone, while on the other hand the accused/applicant handed over his mobile phone to the Investigating Officer.
One of the allegations of the prosecutrix is that the accused/applicant clicked her pictures and videos in nude.
On this issue, This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/07/2025 at 22:12:00 in response to a specific query, the Investigating Officer/SI Shruti submits that the mobile phone of the accused/applicant has been sent to FSL but in the case diary recorded by the previous Investigating Officer, there is no mention of any pictures/videos found in the mobile phone of the accused/applicant.
4. Learned APP accepts notice and seeks and is allowed two weeks to file status report.
Nominal rolls also be requisitioned.
5. Notice be also issued to the prosecutrix through Investigating Officer.
